song_craft: Voice: stotra-address couplets — Abhinavagupta’s own hymn, first person throughout, vocatives load-bearing every verse (row 7). Arc: veneration-by-becoming (v1) → two-step recognition (v2) → fear-denied-suffering-kept (v3) → death defied (v4) → fearlessness finished (v5) → awakening→ingress (v6) → affliction-as-occasion (v7) → rites relativized (v8) → dancing consciousness (v9) → dated seal cooling the world (v10). Recognition performed, not argued. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: O Ender — turn from me this most wrathful and terrible gaze.
Steadfast in Śaṅkara’s service and contemplation, I am filled with dread Bhairava-power.
l4.sanskrit_cite: antaka māṃ prati mā dṛśam enāṃ krodhakarālatamāṃ vinidhehi śaṅkarasevanacintanadhīro bhīṣaṇabhairavaśaktimayo 'smi

verses.craft: Prayer then ground (power declared as state); asmi open kept (achieved vs performative); Śaṅkara=Śiva resolved by context.
verses.rejected: (a) resolving asmi → killed by UNC. (b) begging tone → killed: state, not begging.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'asmi' is a declaration of achieved state or a performative utterance is unresolved.", "Whether 'śaṅkara' could refer to Śaṅkarācārya is resolved as Śiva by context."]) / C1 essence / rasa vīra (heroism) with adbhuta (wonder) / L2+L3 voice
